title.zh: Morning Minute: Binance’s $6.4B Hack Overshadows Hyperliquid’s Biggest Day
title.en: Morning Minute: Binance’s $6.4B Hack Overshadows Hyperliquid’s Biggest Day

current_state.zh: Binance suffered a roughly $6.4B multi-chain theft, the largest crypto hack ever, prompting SAFU-backed loss coverage while AAVE froze Ethereum markets and Polymarket paused trading.
